issues.detail: The Hebrew lists 'וְזָבָד בְּנוֹ וְשׁוּתֶלַח בְּנוֹ וְעֵזֶר וְאֶלְעָד' — 'Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead.' The Chinese renders 'וְעֵזֶר' as '幫助者' (helper), which is a mistranslation of the proper name 'Ezer' (עֵזֶר), not a common noun. This changes the identity of the person from a named individual to a generic descriptor.
